title: A wolf pack with minds
about: The island's bold road pack of four (adults nearest the arrival point) is the subject: LIVING_ONLY names all four, and the mind routes them by the models file's species map. rules.minds is true so that seeded animals are thought for by the admin's minds; no person has a mind. The authority asks an animal's mind only while a person is within 25 tiles. Variant `instinct` runs the same world with no mind: the instinct-only control.
gradient: Hunting, pack cohesion and survival against the instinct-only pack; calls and tokens per wolf-hour.
